name: Gift of the Metallic Dragon
description:
You've manifested some of the power of metallic dragons, granting you the following benefits:
- **Draconic Healing.** You can take a Stress as a Major Action to heal a creature you are touching. The target regains 1d10 + your proficiency bonus hit points.
- **Protective Wings.** You can manifest protective wings that can shield you or others. When a creature you can see within 5 ft. of you is hit by an attack roll, you can expend Heroic Inspiration to halve the damage.
